comparison.objective: Feed springy filament into a 3D-printer feeder inlet.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual flexible-line straightening, tight-clearance tip alignment, and axial insertion without kinking.
comparison.success_condition: Filament end is at least 20 mm inside, released and still; kinking, spool loss, or falling invalidates.
comparison.reason: Flexible filament insertion into one bore differs from bulk rigid-body sifting, bridge clearing, and retained washer preservation. No material rubric detail is missing.
